name: alignments
title: Alignments
description: Table with pairwise geometric relationships between media files from the same fixed point. Used by the Repeat Photo profile so later frames can be compared to earlier ones. The standard records the relationship; it does not specify an alignment algorithm.

fields.name: locationID
fields.description: Fixed-point location shared by both media files.

fields.name: referenceMediaID
fields.description: Earlier or canonical frame. Foreign key to `media.mediaID`.

fields.name: alignedMediaID
fields.description: Later or compared frame. Foreign key to `media.mediaID`.

fields.name: transform
fields.description: Geometric transform taking `alignedMediaID` into the reference frame. JSON object (e.g. 3x3 homography matrix) or a path to a sidecar file.

fields.name: residualError
fields.description: Reported alignment residual, typically RMSE in pixels.

fields.name: alignedBy
fields.description: Person or software that produced the alignment.

fields.name: alignmentTimestamp
fields.description: Date and time the alignment was produced. ISO 8601 with timezone designator.

fields.name: alignmentComments
fields.description: Comments or notes about the alignment.
